title: ‘All About the Money’ Doc Maker Explains How She Updated Her Film on Fergie Chambers After His Arrest – and Her Concerns About That U.S. Extradition Request
summary: Irish director Sinéad O’Shea is gearing up for much debate as the film comes into U.K. and Irish cinemas on Oct. 30 after its BFI London Film Festival run and before screening at DOC NYC in November.
